purpose: Purpose Relief from sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes and sinus congestion.*
indications_and_usage: Uses This product is a homeopathic dilution, formulated to support the body's immunity for the temporary relief of allergies.*
warnings: Warnings Use only as directed. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms worsen or do not improve after 7 days. If pregnant or breast-feeding, consult a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.

pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: If pregnant or breast-feeding, consult a health professional before use.

dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults 12 years and older: chew 1 tablet, 2-3 times daily Children under 12 years: consult a doctor
